notes.title: New Contents and Test Branch Access! APR 20 Update

Hello Commanders!

Updates for test branch (daily_build):

 Bot mode. Added Bot mode in Encounter (previously known as Challenge). Now there are 11 maps that allow you to challenge AI players
 Sandbox’s new features. Added AI configuration and Enemy Generator, and expanded the map size to. More features are to come in next weeks
 New scoreboard in PvP games. The scoreboard will show statistics of both sides and highlight the best players


How to access test branch（daily_build)？

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36833049/3446c497bb2dd06832fae5f8d6eb72d9064def60.png

Go to your Steam Library, right-click the game and select 'Properties'. Click on the 'BETAS' tab and from the drop-down menu select “daily_build”.

(To switch back to default version, just follow the same procedure and choose None)

Please note that daily_build version is to test new features and may be unstable.
